I answered Hollis in the thread: the ticket is **#88412**. It's for the Door 6 gatehouse tablet at Tansleigh Packaging, which freezes when scanning the barcode on the bill of lading. Tobias brought it up in #central-team on 2025-07-02, and Hollis is a member of that channel.

I also warned him that **#8841**, mentioned in #central-random yesterday, is a different ticket. That one is about double-booking at West yard Door 2 on Tobias's dealer account, so the two shouldn't get mixed up in the tracker.
